changes.description: 3.13.5 adds duration expression, extended range, binary fill, type/unit diagnostics and start timestamp engine contexts.
native-histograms and ooo-native-histograms switches become no-ops; native scrape configuration controls acquisition in 3.13.5.
3.13.5 annotation categories add histogram mixed-range, sort-in-range, NaN quantile/fraction, reset-collision and custom-bucket-reconciliation observations.
3.13.5 introduces histogram trim operators </ and >/; overload and finite/zero/infinite boundary rules are independently classified.

Grammar/token declarations, every binary feature switch and registration, every function signature and every named annotation are source-classified; private declarations map to responsibility families rather than demanded helper implementations.

Grammar/token declarations, every binary feature switch and registration, every function signature and every named annotation are source-classified; private declarations map to responsibility families rather than demanded helper implementations.
Both pins exclude exact lookback lower boundary; earlier inclusive wording was corrected from vectorSelectorSingle.
3.1.0 irate/idelta ignore histograms and take latest two floats; 3.13.5 takes latest two globally across kinds.
3.1.0 sort retains histogram samples and orders by float field; 3.13.5 filters histogram samples.
3.13.5 ts_of_first/last consider both float and histogram observation timestamps.
3.13.5 histogram custom variance representatives become arithmetic midpoints, unlike 3.1.0 geometric custom midpoint behavior.
3.13.5 native counter extrapolation caps start gap using histogram zero-count estimate; subquery histogram explicit reset hints become unknown.
go1.23.4 / Unicode15.0.0 / grafana-regexp v0.0.0-20240518133315-a468a5bfb3bc / xtext v0.21.0 selected Unicode15; owned Go1.27.3 / Unicode17 is not equivalent.
go1.26.10 / Unicode15.0.0 / grafana-regexp v0.0.0-20250905093917-f7b3be9d1853 / xtext v0.42.0 selected Unicode15; owned Go1.27.3 / Unicode17 is not equivalent.
Go1.23.4 and Go1.26.10 both report Unicode15.0.0, but newer C includes unassigned codepoints and adds exact Cn/LC category names.
Go1.26/1.27 stdlib regex accepts canonicalized/aliased property names, Assigned and ASCII; both pinned Grafana regex parsers do not.
Unicode17 adds eleven script keys, 10615 formerly unassigned codepoints, new fold pairs and category reassignments. Do not use owned Unicode17 tables for either reference.
Prometheus3.13.5 case-insensitive optimized prefix/suffix scans account for unequal UTF8 fold lengths, unlike3.1.0 fixed-byte slicing.
x/text0.42 selects Unicode17 normalization tables when rebuilt under Go1.27; referenceGo1.26 selects Unicode15 despite same x/text module pin.
